<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brand" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#00FBFF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#09C9E3"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="17" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="13" x2="315" y2="17" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="11" x2="320" y2="17" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="9" x2="325" y2="17" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="340" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="15" x2="345" y2="18" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="354" y="8" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="376" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#0D0543"/>
    <rect x="356" y="10" width="14" height="7" rx="2" fill="#0D0543"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="27,48 20,55 27,62" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="55" x2="35" y2="55" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="48" y="61" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Return request</text>
    <line x1="16" y1="79" x2="374" y2="79" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Success message -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="116" r="25" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <polyline points="183,116 191,124 207,107" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="161" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Return request submitted</text>
    <text x="195" y="184" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">We’ll keep you updated at every step.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Vertical five-step progress -->
  <g>
    <line x1="48" y1="220" x2="48" y2="548" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="220" x2="48" y2="302" stroke="#09C9E3" stroke-width="3"/>

    <circle cx="48" cy="220" r="17" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <polyline points="40,220 46,226 57,214" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="78" y="216" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Request submitted</text>
    <text x="78" y="237" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Today, 9:41 AM</text>

    <circle cx="48" cy="302" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="302" r="5" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <text x="78" y="298" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Request under review</text>
    <text x="78" y="319" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Usually completed within 24 hours</text>

    <circle cx="48" cy="384" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="41" y="378" width="14" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="44" y1="375" x2="44" y2="381" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="375" x2="52" y2="381" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="78" y="380" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Pickup scheduled</text>
    <text x="78" y="401" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">A pickup date will appear here</text>

    <circle cx="48" cy="466" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="39" y="461" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="457" x2="43" y2="464" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="457" x2="53" y2="464" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="78" y="462" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Refund initiated</text>
    <text x="78" y="483" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">After the item is received</text>

    <circle cx="48" cy="548" r="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="40,548 46,554 57,542" fill="none" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="78" y="544" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Return completed</text>
    <text x="78" y="565" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">You’ll receive a confirmation</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Order summary card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="596" width="356" height="2" rx="1" fill="#1018280D"/>
    <rect x="16" y="594" width="358" height="104" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="28" y="608" width="62" height="62" rx="8" fill="#CFCBDC"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="622" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="35,661 51,641 60,651 68,643 84,661" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="104" y="618" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">ORDER #RF-482719</text>
    <text x="104" y="641" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Wireless noise-cancelling headphones</text>
    <text x="104" y="663" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0D0543">Refund to original payment method · $89.99</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="716" width="356" height="42" rx="8" fill="#1018280D"/>
    <rect x="16" y="714" width="358" height="42" rx="8" fill="url(#brand)"/>
    <text x="195" y="741" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Track return</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="779" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Manage request</text>
    <line x1="140" y1="783" x2="250" y2="783" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="796" width="390" height="48" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="796" x2="390" y2="796" stroke="#CFCBDC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="38,812 47,804 56,812 56,821 50,821 50,815 44,815 44,821 38,821" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="47" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Home</text>

    <circle cx="130" cy="811" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="136" y1="817" x2="142" y2="823" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="130" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Search</text>

    <rect x="202" y="803" width="18" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="202" y1="809" x2="220" y2="809" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="206" y1="800" x2="206" y2="806" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="216" y1="800" x2="216" y2="806" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="211" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#0D0543">Orders</text>

    <circle cx="320" cy="808" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="821" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#0D0543" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="320" y="838" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#0D0543">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
